name: warrior
title: Warrior
subject: A platformer hero in profile, dressed for a fight: plate armour (leather as the other look of every piece) and a weapon slot that holds a sword, a spear, a bow or an axe.
intent: One dressable skeleton for a side-scroller: a guard stance and an attack for each weapon, a punch with no weapon, a run and a jump. The body drives every blow and the feet stay planted where they stand while the hips shift.
teaches: a run with a moment in the air

clips.name: idle_sword
clips.does: guard stance, sword up and forward, breathing over planted feet

clips.name: attack_sword
clips.does: raise the sword overhead, cut down and forward driven by the hips, hold the hit, recover

clips.name: idle_spear
clips.does: spear level at the hip, both hands on it, breathing

clips.name: attack_spear
clips.does: draw back, thrust with the whole body, hold, recover

clips.name: idle_bow
clips.does: bow low in the near hand, relaxed

clips.name: shoot_bow
clips.does: raise the bow, draw to the cheek, hold, release with a recoil

clips.name: punch
clips.does: no weapon: guard, a short pull back, a straight punch from the hips, hold, recover

clips.name: run
clips.does: two strides with a moment in the air after each push-off, arms opposite the legs, sword in hand

clips.name: jump
clips.does: crouch with the feet planted, launch, tuck at the top, land into a planted crouch and stand
